rule: Cross-cutting services are persistent stores/managers and do not occupy one chronological position in a Sequence.

services.name: Open-Sequence Ledger
services.purpose: Track every active/suspended Sequence, required return, barrier, terminal status, and return acceptance.

services.name: Gap Ledger
services.purpose: Track missing source, dependency, evaluator, threshold, identity, relation, evidence, result producer, input, return or contract.

services.name: Contradiction Register
services.purpose: Preserve incompatible supported claims and their scope instead of silently merging them.

services.name: Evidence Ledger
services.purpose: Bind evidence to claims/tests/verification with provenance, independence and strength.

services.name: Proof-Debt Ledger
services.purpose: Track claims whose required proof depth exceeds current proof depth and whether debt blocks closure.

services.name: Claim Registry
services.purpose: Store machine-relevant assertions as first-class records with source, evidence, view and epistemic state.

services.name: Identity Registry
services.purpose: Track identity basis, continuity criteria, transformations, splits, merges and competing identity claims.

services.name: Threshold Registry
services.purpose: Version and evaluate threshold definitions independently from triggers and nodes.

services.name: Rule/Promise Registry
services.purpose: Store constraints, permissions, prohibitions, promises, priorities, exception terms and activation conditions.

services.name: Seed Registry
services.purpose: Store latent results/commitments/future-action seeds independently from the open Sequence ledger.

services.name: Sequence-Relation Registry
services.purpose: Track MAIN, LOCAL/RIDER, ATTACHED, NEXT, REFERENCE, COUNTER, OBSERVER, AUDIT, PARALLEL, CONVERGENT and other typed Sequence relations.

services.name: Actor/View Registry
services.purpose: Keep actor/system knowledge and beliefs separate from Global Reality.

services.name: Rubric Registry
services.purpose: Store orthogonal rubric dimensions and evaluations without mutating native domain registries.

services.name: Template/Version Registry
services.purpose: Separate template/schema evolution from immutable historical execution instances.

services.name: Event/State Ledger
services.purpose: Version states/events with event, observation, record and processing times.

services.name: Concurrency/Lock Manager
services.purpose: Track resource/dependency locks, wait-for graphs, deadlocks, races, starvation, timeouts, transactions and synchronization gates.

services.name: Human-Handoff Queue
services.purpose: Route source gaps, normative choices, authorization, identity/scope choices, proof-debt acceptance and unresolved contradictions to a human when required.

services.name: Migration Registry
services.purpose: Track schema/template/record migrations, backward compatibility, deprecation, rollback, archive and canonical status.
